notes.title: Patch №1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41606713/cda5f872cd5e7e5df060887183eae657fcc54d9b.jpg[/img]
[h1]Greetings Grandmasters of Kill King! [/h1]

We hope you had fun playing rpg chess ♟ 

We just released a small update that fixes various bugs and includes some minor improvements to the game. 

We also added tutorials, with different difficulty levels. You'll be able to practice before going online :)

And now more about all the updates:

[b]NEW NEWS[/b]
 ⁃ Added 14 different AIs with progressive difficulty.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41606713/65c71461398cf0100e8b10f9640df7e2d58b0dfa.jpg[/img]
 ⁃ You can cancel the current order of the selected figure with the "Esc" button
 ⁃ When you hover your mouse over a character's skill, a tooltip describing the characteristic of the figure pops up. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41606713/0e5df7c1e4792d28bc98c2a7a0da63d2e78d6711.jpg[/img]

[b]UI[/b]
 ⁃ The figure that executes the order is highlighted by a white circle.
[previewyoutube=DGluP-LycrQ;full][/previewyoutube]

⁃ The current action when executed is displayed above the figure's head. The icon appears: walk, attack or heal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41606713/27148f805272e1ec62239378a957e6eb23957717.jpg[/img]
 ⁃ Fixed UI bug that caused the menu to not close when pressing "Esc".
 ⁃ Fixed an issue where re-selecting a character was unavailable

[b]KINEMATICS[/b]
 ⁃ Fixed several cinematic problems related to camera angles, animation, depth of field, surfacing, lighting, and clipping.
 ⁃ Graphics quality can now be corrected immediately in the main menu when entering the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41606713/f30b4cd4d648bc0d0e0b6d4e266bb56a12810c47.jpg[/img]

[b]CRASHES AND BLOCKERS[/b]
 ⁃ If an action cannot be performed, a corresponding reaction will be triggered: the figure will be highlighted in red and a sound 
[previewyoutube=-6AN6N8y7uM;full][/previewyoutube]

 ⁃ Fixed a bug where you could not see the total damage dealt to enemy figures
[previewyoutube=gRD0XBZcX9k;full][/previewyoutube]


❤️ Thanks to everyone who reported bugs and problems in the game! We hope you appreciate all the fixes and changes!

Have a great week!
 ⁃ Kill King 👑
